rules.paraphrase: Maximum hourly rates of 290 dollars for partners, 205 for associates and 90 for paralegals and law clerks.
Time is recorded daily to the nearest tenth; the only acceptable minimum charge is 0.1 hour.
Block billing, lumping several distinct tasks into one entry, is not permitted and may be rejected.
Vague or generic descriptions are not appropriate; documents, correspondents and call participants are identified.
Duplicate charges for intra-firm conferences between attorneys are not billable.
No charge for routine research, and research projects over four hours need approval.
Bill monthly and at least quarterly; amounts under 500 dollars wait until the next period.
Bills name each timekeeper with rate and totals, separate each matter and show copy counts.
Copies at actual cost not above ten cents; third-party disbursements over 500 dollars are coordinated in advance.
General overhead such as administrative services, research databases, phone, fax and supplies is not reimbursed.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: The responsible partner reviews the invoice before sending.
Settlements above 30,000 dollars need prior approval.
